description: Read-only. Live search of bookable tours and activities in Vail, Colorado from Viator's partner API. Returns title, live starting ('from') price and currency, rating, review count, duration, free-cancellation flag, image and a booking_url. Optional start_date/end_date return only products Viator lists as available on those dates. Default order: keyword relevance when q is given, otherwise traveler rating; 'featured' uses Viator's own default order. booking_url is the Viator booking page and a Viator affiliate link: VailVacay may earn a commission if the user books, at no extra cost to them. Viator confirms the final price, availability and cancellation terms before payment.

sort.description: Default: relevance to q when q is given (Viator keyword match), otherwise rating (highest traveler rating first). featured = Viator's own default order.

name: search_tours
title: Search Vail, Colorado tours and activities (Viator)
